name: federation-web
description: FederationWeb — Open Federated Database Web Client

scripts.build:css: sass bootstrap/scss/main.scss src/WebResources/css/federation.css --style=compressed --source-map --load-path=node_modules --quiet-deps && sass bootstrap/scss/main.scss src/WebResources/css/federation.dev.css --style=expanded --source-map --load-path=node_modules --quiet-deps && sass bootstrap/scss/print.scss src/WebResources/css/print.css --style=compressed --source-map --load-path=node_modules --quiet-deps
scripts.build: npm run build:vendor && npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.dev: npm run build && npx live-server dist --port=8080 --no-browser
